title: Discrimination.
bodyText: No person shall be denied the right to become a lessee of a residential lot, because of the person's race, religion, sex, ancestry, or a physical handicap.
bodyHtml: §516-62  Discrimination.  No person shall be denied the right to become a lessee of a residential lot, because of the person's race, religion, sex, ancestry, or a physical handicap. [L 1967, c 307, §35; HRS §516-62; am L 1976, c 159, §8; gen ch 1985]
